notes: End-to-end answer gold set for the Nimbus sample documents, run through the full router with the real LLM. `facts`: the answer must contain at least one (any-of) or every (all-of) string; matching ignores case and thousands separators. `doc`: the document that must be cited. Out-of-scope questions must be declined (route fallback, or a canned reply), never answered. Small-talk questions must take the intent fast path.
